race.comment: SUNROE (9) brings the immediate winning form after landing a BM50 at Wagga Riverside as a well-supported favourite, with weight relief helping offset the rise in grade. BELNERA (6) was strong late when fourth in Class 3 grade at this venue and, with proven track-and-trip form, has the right profile to be running into a placing again. GLENN'S LEGACY (5) Class 1 second last start was solid and the claim helps, but he is untried around 1600m and must prove the trip. Well placed and the claim will assist. In the mix. DOC MARCH (1) back from a five-month break after winning a trial at Wagga Riverside. Placed fresh last prep and can feature.
